clauses: This distinguished scientist and university teacher has significantly advanced our understanding of biological processes.

Throughout their highly decorated career, they have received several major accolades, including the Harvey Prize, the Canada Gairdner International Award, and the prestigious Croonian Medal and Lecture.

Notably, despite their profound impact on the life sciences, they have never been awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, nor did they ever pursue their education at the University of Oxford.
